cues: Several causes, E one and E two, each can produce an effect W. Going forwards along the tree, multiply along the paths.
The total probability of W is the sum of the paths that end in W.
text: Bayes' theorem reasons backwards. Several causes, E one and E two, each can produce an effect W. Going forwards along the tree, multiply along the paths. The total probability of W is the sum of the paths that end in W.
